newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: T&N details share capitalisation award.
newsitem.headline: T&N details share capitalisation award.

text.p: South Africa's T&N Holdings Ltd on Monday detailed its share capitalisation award of fully paid ordinary shares in a ratio of 1.3077 new ordinary shares for every 100 held by investors registered by September 20.
If the entitlement ends in a fraction of share then the balance is to be settled by a cash dividend based on an issue price of 13 rands a share, the firm said.
The new ordinary shares are to be listed on October 28.
T&N Holdings is 50 percent owned by Britain's T&N Group Plc and is involved in automotive components and engineering.
